jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 용도지역지구 도형 lane `land-use-zone-area` (root ADR-0169 ③, ADR-0362): pick the newest vintage whose AL_D<layer>_00 shapefiles cover every layer the lane contract lists, read from the ZIP members measured beside the Bronze ledger, and, unless silver.land_use_zone_area already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export each layer (geometry reprojected to EPSG:4326 WKB), compare it, in the publisher's DuckDB, with the table's current rows one layer (compare bucket) at a time and append to main only the changed areas' rows and a removal marker per vanished area (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0311, ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). A run that reaches its time limit leaves the layers it did not compare to the next run. Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two of the duckdb pool's runs go at a time, lanes or other in-process work: each holds one of its slots and a memory_claim on its unit (root ADR-0599, ADR-0605).
jobs.memory_measured: 2026-11-21, building-register-units. Under 16G: three runs, export 6m47s-7m00s CPU and about 10 minutes of wall time, `memory peak` 13.3-13.4G. Under the 8G this cap was for one day: one run, 61 minutes (17:37:58-18:39:25Z), 10m35s CPU, `memory peak` 7.2G - the export child held 6.68G resident and the cgroup sat at MemoryHigh with 18,933 `high` events and no OOM kill: throttled, not killed. journal `memory peak` 2026-10-18..11-08, 84 runs under 16G: highest 15,668M on 2026-10-20 (building-register-unit-areas). The other lanes measured on the DuckDB path the same day: 0.3G-7.1G.
jobs.memory_headroom_why: A measured working point, not 1.5 x a peak: the export sizes its workers to three quarters of what its cgroup has left, so its peak follows the cap, but about 7G of it does not shrink - at 8G nothing was left for it to work in. 16G is the cap under which the largest export is measured to finish in ten minutes. One number for all 54 lanes, because they share one unit template: it over-reserves for the small lanes (1-7G), and a request per lane comes with the Dagster resource tags that replace this admission (root ADR-0583 follow-up).
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: no silver-refresh.sh report in the unit's journal 2026-10-12..11-26; 2G is the computed floor of a Silver release copy, its stage database and staged files. The stage logs `duckdb stage closed: disk_bytes=<n>` as it closes (root ADR-0622); a pull request replaces this bound with the highest logged value, nothing is kept between runs.

expected_outcome.basis: Bronze land use zones are collected daily; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): the Silver lane changed once. A month and a day without one is a lane that stopped.

assets.title: 용도지역지구 구역
assets.description: 브이월드 용도지역지구 도형(NA/24) 중 처음 서빙하는 15개 층(개발제한구역·도시계획시설 7종·공장설립제한/승인지역·산업집적 용도구역·농업진흥지역·도시/농림/자연환경보전지역)의 구역과 EPSG:4326 도형(루트 ADR-0362). 판이 오면 층마다 바뀐 구역의 행만 덧붙인다. 필지별 저촉은 필지별 토지이용계획이 가진다.
